scope: Local fictional fixtures only; no measured application downtime. Each retained row passed full verify_snapshot after capture.
limitations: Shared host; initial 2 GiB candidate trials overlapped offline tests.
Initial baseline and parallel trials used advisory eviction without mincore residency or idle probe recording.
Large baseline was stopped after one completed and fully verified cold case; no other baseline large cases are represented.
Per-file telemetry gained a cutover field after the initial candidate trials; each report records its actual aws_ops.py SHA-256.
The read probe is tiny and cached; it cannot establish production request latency under parallel I/O.
restore_verification_seconds was added after large trials, but all successful rows were recorded only after full verification.
